bitcoin_articles.headline: Strive CEO Comments on Institutional Bitcoin Adoption Timeline
bitcoin_articles.summary: Strive, Inc. CEO stated that institutional adoption of Bitcoin is expected to reach widespread levels within four years.

bitcoin_articles.headline: MARA Holdings Transfers 1,000 Bitcoin to BitGo
bitcoin_articles.summary: MARA Holdings, Inc. has transferred 1,000 Bitcoin, valued at approximately $80.66 million, to the digital asset custodian BitGo.

bitcoin_articles.headline: B HODL PLC Announces Audited Final Results for the Year Ended 30 June 2026
bitcoin_articles.summary: B HODL PLC reported its audited financial results for the 2026 fiscal year, detailing a loss before tax of £7.84 million and providing an update on its Bitcoin treasury holdings.
